flyer.justification: The flyer is concise, adheres strictly to the title length and format constraints, and accurately highlights the main themes of the talk.

instagram.justification: The post includes clear carousel slide visual cues, short emoji-accented lines, a strong call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

linkedin.justification: The LinkedIn post presents key insights in clean paragraphs, avoids forbidden cliches/buzzwords, and includes exactly five relevant hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary perfectly covers the required structural sections (TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, action items) well under the 400-word limit.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all formatting rules, including a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct bold subheadings, and a conversational tone.

blog.justification: The long-form article is well structured with numbered sections, an impact comparison table, a strong conclusion, and an author bio matching the profile.
